issue.title: sase_artifact skill documents -n label flag and move semantics; CLI uses -l and copies by default
issue.description: Repro: `sase artifact create -p <file> -n "label"` exits 2 with 'unrecognized arguments: -n'. `sase artifact create --help` shows the label flag is `-l/--label`, and that the default is copy (`-m/--move` removes the source). The rendered skill at ~/.claude/skills/sase_artifact/SKILL.md (sase-provided skill, sourced from the sase repo) says `-n, --label` in both the Workflow and Options sections and says 'The command moves the file into SASE artifact storage'. Fix belongs in the sase repo's skill source (open it with /sase_repo), then re-render.

task_type_fields.proposed_change: Replace `-n "<label>"` with `-l "<label>"` in the Workflow example and `-n, --label` with `-l, --label` in Options; replace 'The command moves the file into SASE artifact storage, so do not edit the original path after registration' with: copies by default, pass `-m/--move` to remove the source; the stored copy will not track later edits to the original. Optionally document `-b/--bead`.

issue.creation_reason: Following the sase_artifact skill verbatim failed with 'unrecognized arguments: -n' while registering artifacts on 2026-10-01; the skill also wrongly warns the file is moved.
